targets.title: News can Help! The Impact of News Media and Digital Platforms on Awareness of and Belief in Misinformation.
targets.evidence_quote:
Here, we offer a replication of Altay et al. (2023) who tested the effects of news use on awareness of and
belief in COVID-19 misinformation.
targets.outcome_quote:
Overall, this replication reinforces the conclusion of the original article by Altay
et al. (2023).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The explicit overall verdict governs despite differences in individual associations.

reasoning: A different two-country sample retests the published news-use findings. Overall author verdict supports replication.
